contract: The high watermark is the minimum log end of the current ISR and does not move backward.
acks=1 can succeed from the leader alone. acks=-1 stays pending until the high watermark covers the records and the ISR is at least min.insync.replicas.
An ISR below the minimum after the leader append returns NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS_AFTER_APPEND and does not commit the id.
Committed ids remain after failover to a caught-up ISR member and after reopen.
limits: This is not a Produce RPC and it does not replicate bytes. Replica progress is supplied by the caller.
Leader epoch recovery after divergence stays on KL11-20.
The journal format is the local PLHWMK01 record, not an Apache record batch.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
